translations.O056/unit/ubertip: |cffa0d2a0Zul'jin|r — leader of the Amani forest trolls, was chieftain of the Amani tribe even before the Second War. Zul'jin and his trolls were allied with the orcs of the Horde during the Second War, at the very end of which Zul'jin himself was captured by Alliance forces. After his escape he went into hiding, rebuilding his army and planning attacks on the remnants of the high elves, now known as blood elves, who have allied with the Horde. For unknown reasons the Loa abandoned Zul'jin, reflected in the missing arm and eye that would long since have regenerated on an ordinary troll.
